title: Entity Replicator
text: Replicate entities, 1 input, 2 outputs; {Replicas depart from} sets how replicas depart Separate, {Replication amount source} sets the source of replica, {Number of replicas} sets the number of replicas, {Replicate attribute name} sets the attribute that determines the number of replicas and {Hold original entity until all replicas depart} sets how replicas depart. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output replica entity scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: Output the entity that is replicated scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Replicas depart from
params.values: Choose how replicas depart Separate output ports (default) | Single output port

params.name: Replication amount source
params.values: Specify source of replica number Dialog (default) | Attribute

params.name: Number of replicas
params.values: Specify the number of replicas 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Replicate attribute name
params.values: Specify the attribute that determines the number of replicas ReplicateAttribute (default) | character vector

params.name: Hold original entity until all replicas depart
params.values: Choose how replicas depart off (default) | on
